pattern.description: Screen recording: clicking Give feedback dims the app with a grey scrim in about two frames while the Share your thoughts dialog fades in on top, still translucent when the burst ends.
pattern.why_premium: Standard product modal entrance shown as-is; the instant scrim followed by a softer dialog fade separates focus layers without moving the layout.

build_hint.remotion: scrimOpacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 2], [0, 0.5], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); dialogOpacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); no spring.

notes: Burst is only ~100 ms (two-frame energy spike), so the dialog fade continues past the event end; dialog box is manual. Close to notification_pop but no scale/pop, hence other.
